clips.title: The story
paras: A young priest leaves Coldridge Valley for further study in Kharanos during In Favor of the Light. Branstock Khalder sends novitiates through the mountain tunnel to Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol, where they take on greater responsibilities and can earn their first formal vestments.

Dwarven priests begin their studies in Coldridge Valley under instructors such as Branstock Khalder. When a novice shows dedication and understanding of Holy magic, Khalder sends them beyond the mountains to Kharanos. There, priests face the needs of Dun Morogh's people, including their daily struggles and defense.

You reach Kharanos by traveling through the Coldridge Pass tunnel into central Dun Morogh. Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol guides students beyond basic prayers. He teaches that service to the Holy Light calls for moral character, physical hardiness, and an unyielding will. Students who prove their resolve under his guidance may receive their first formal garments of office.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ya been following the Light now for long enough that you find your way to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. He'll teach ya more about the path yer following, and if you prove worthy, give ya yer first set of robes to denote your station as a priestess.
Now get goin'! As soon as yer done here, head through the tunnel--he'll be waitin' for ya.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, so Branstock sent ya, did he? Good, good! He's right, it is 'bout time you started taking a much larger step into the Light. It'll build character and make ya stronger... An' that's what you'll need more than anything: strength of body... Strength of will.
